notes.title: Hunt Grounds Demo Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252798/a10ed1273483a561378364ae88678f65cfac0eb7.png

Survivors, beware, the Hunt Grounds have become even more dangerous! In this update, we've introduced several major improvements to the demo:

🔹 Traitor Mechanic – A survivor may secretly be working against the group. Stay alert! The traitor wields the Oathbreaker, a sinister horn that sends out a haunting call, revealing nearby survivors within its range. 
🔹 Improved Character Movement & Interaction – Smoother controls for a better experience.
🔹 Melee Combat – Survivors can now fight back in close encounters.
🔹 Supernatural Item Effects – More impactful and visually enhanced abilities.
🔹 Reduced Stamina Consumption – Sprint longer and strategize your escape.
